conviction_note: Elopak has not filed a trading update ahead of Q3, although it filed one in March 2026 when results tracked below its own published consensus. Q3 European LDPE contract prices eased while the Q2 customer surcharges are taking effect, which supports the company's guided EMEA margin recovery. Against that, the Longview board supplier was idle through the quarter. The two sides roughly offset, the lean is a mild up-tilt (p_up 53), and the move is sized at 6% because the numbers are new and turnover is thin. The scaled +0.36 sits close to the +0.4 sum of findings.

findings.finding: No trading update or profit warning has been filed before the Q3 print (NewsWeb, 1 Jun to 26 Oct 2026). In March 2026 Elopak issued an MAR trading update as soon as preliminary figures showed a shortfall against expectations, and it publishes its own collected consensus, so a material Q3 miss against 48.4m would most likely already have been warned.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 2026 warning cost -1.2% on its day. The Q1 print then rose +5.3% once the bad news was out. Q3 prints rose +11.1% (2023) and +7.4% (2025), and Q2 2026, a slight miss against 45.3m, fell -7.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market read the absence of a warning as a floor, the stock would not have drifted down about 4.4% ex-dividend over 20 sessions into the print, toward the NOK 33 lows and below the NOK 36.40 buy-back price of September. This is an inference from absence, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The issuer-history list on NewsWeb shows no category-1005 inside-information filing since the 15 Jun CEO appointment: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/list?issuer=ELO&fromDate=2026-06-01&toDate=2026-10-27

findings.finding: European LDPE contract prices fell in Q3 (July contract -EUR 150/t week-on-week to EUR 2,600-2,605/t after the July ethylene settlement; about EUR 2,540/t in early September). Meanwhile the customer raw-material surcharges Elopak put in place in Q2 are taking effect. Consensus has the EMEA margin flat at 17.7% against Q2's 17.8%, so it does not yet model the recovery the company said to expect.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The EMEA margin squeeze in Q2 2026 (17.8% against 18.7%) came with -7.0% on the day. Q3 2025's record 17.0% group margin came with +7.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: The median EMEA margin in published consensus is 17.8%, equal to Q2's, so analysts have not modelled surcharge catch-up against easing PE. If they had, the EMEA line would be above Q2. The offset is that board is the larger input: Billerud says LPB market conditions were stable and that price rises are offsetting energy inflation. That is a cost for Elopak, so the finding is kept small and is a macro-to-company proxy.
findings.independence: Elopak's own Q2 report says 'Customer surcharges have been implemented to mitigate the impact, with recovery expected in the coming quarters' (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=680034). Counterweight: Billerud Q3, 2026-10-22: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bf1a63c3fcd71b3bc6c3d2904b73823cf&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: Nippon Dynawave's Longview mill, an Elopak liquid-packaging-board supplier, stayed largely idle through Q3. Workers were recalled only around 12 October with no restart date, and pay was extended to 17 January. Americas therefore carried constrained-supply costs and inefficiencies through the school-milk season, with insurance recoveries possibly lagging.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This was first disclosed in the Q2 2026 report (-7.0% day). Americas has otherwise been the stock's positive line: the Q3 2025 Little Rock profitability came with +7.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced. The company flagged constrained supply 'through the second half of 2026 and ... potentially into 2027', and consensus trims the Americas margin to 22.2% from Q2's 22.9%. What remains is the unknown timing of insurance recovery and whether costs are taken as adjusting items. It is inside what the company guided, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: SIG's H1 2026 report shows European aseptic carton revenue -3.1%, citing a contracting ambient juice market and fewer customer wins in UHT milk tenders. Elopak named the same aseptic-juice decline as a 2026 driver, which caps EMEA volume upside.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: European softness was named in the March 2026 trading update (-1.2%) and the Q1 print (+5.3% after the pre-release).
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: a July peer datapoint already reflected in the consensus EMEA revenue of 220.9m. It is filed as a small negative because it bears on the volume line.
findings.independence: Elopak Q1 2026 trading update: 'decline in aseptic juice market in a price competitive environment' https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=669031

findings.finding: After the Q2 drop, the interim CEO and other primary insiders bought shares, and Nordea Funds crossed 5% (5.03%, 13.56m shares), both on 2026-08-19.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There are no prior instances to compare.
findings.why_not_priced: The buying is two months old and public, and the stock has since fallen from about 35 to 33. It is mostly priced. The only residual is that the interim CEO bought with knowledge of the H2 trajectory.

outside_window.finding: New CEO Håkon Volldal starts on 2 Nov 2026, brought forward. A strategy or target reset, or a kitchen-sink at Q4 or a capital markets day, is more likely under him than in this interim-presented Q3 release.
Longview restart and the Americas board supply into 2027, together with the third Little Rock line starting in 2027.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive, against a -6.6% 20-day run-up (about -4.4% ex-dividend) and a priced lean of +0.33. They agree with the run-up-based lean, which is the free control, because no short anchor exists, and the edge over it is small.
language_note: Nothing the English sources did not already carry. Elopak files every release in English on NewsWeb, its consensus file is English, and the Norwegian press (e24 topic page) had no Q3 2026 preview. The NewsWeb category labels in Norwegian ('INNSIDEINFORMASJON', 'ANNEN INFORMASJONSPLIKTIG REGULATORISK INFORMASJON') were what established that no Q3 resultatvarsel was filed.
lessons_applied: 'Numbers not pre-released' (median 7.4%) and thin turnover moved abs_move_pct from 5.5 to 6.0. It stays below 7 because no formal guide exists to change and an interim team presents.
'Finding lands inside what the company guided' moved the surcharge/PE finding from +0.5 to +0.4 and the Longview finding from -0.7 to -0.5, because both were flagged in the Q2 report.
'Proxy loses to primary': the insider/Nordea positioning finding moved from +0.2 to +0.1 and the no-warning inference from +0.7 to +0.6.
'A zero on a register is the truncation floor': positioning_check now says there is no anchor rather than no shorts.
